subject: beachscene
name: 海滩
label: 弯弯的海岸
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. A small uncluttered beach vignette: one curved shoreline, one broad wave line, a simple sun and one large shell. No horizon grid or shading.
Keep the entire little vignette comfortably inside the square with 12 percent clear margin on every side. Draw only the requested main forms, no added decorations.
